unverified: Ostap Veresai: no sound recording of him was found on any fetched page (he is recalled as having died in 1890, before the cylinder work); he is not in the entries.

The brief's 'Kharkiv 1908 Kolessa expedition': the fetched Wikipedia page puts the 12th Archeological Congress (1902) in Kharkiv and Kolessa's invitation in 1908, but does not say where Kolessa recorded; no fetched page names Kharkiv for 1908.

Kolessa 1908 also recorded Opanas Slastion (Plach nevolnykiv) and Ostap Kalnyi, Antin Skoba, Petro Drevchenko (1909, Pro sestru i brata) per the Commons table; not all were put in the playlist to avoid near-duplicate subjects.
